concerns: Evaluating stagnation criteria in the controller using a hardcoded percentage (26.31579) couples the business logic tightly to the current dataset size of 19, which is less flexible for future dataset changes.
The mapping EPIC_TO_DELIVERABLES in EneikReadinessService is hardcoded. If deliverables or task mappings are updated, this code will require modification.

concerns: The Flyway migration class V20260726103849658__fix_deliverable_readiness_metric_calculation uses dynamic, heuristic string-replacement on database view definitions, which can be extremely fragile and error-prone.
